summary: Iteration 23: Spec 2 provider onboarding (registration, phone OTP, 3 tracks, Libretto Famiglia, availability, fee, 5-state machine, admin approval, matching gate) — backend 26/26 pytest PASS. Twilio Verify trial 400 'unverified' cleanly surfaced (not 500). Age gate ✓ (2015 DOB → 400 minor_not_allowed, 1990 OK). Profile: persona_lf/piva → role=provider; impresa → role=business; invalid → 400 invalid_profile_type. LF delega empty → 400 empty_signature; signed → lf_delega_signed=true. INPS toggle persists. Availability PUT persists. /onboarding/config returns fee(visit_fixed_total=8, provider_share=4, recurring_total=6) + 4 condizioni + price_ranges. Submit gate: no phone_verified → 400 phone_not_verified; success → onboarding_completed + provider_state='in_verifica'. Self-suspend {true}→sospeso, {false}→attivo (only when self_suspended). Admin approve of persona_lf w/o INPS → 'attivo_inps_pending'; then INPS true → 'attivo'. All admin actions (approve/waitlist/reject/suspend/convert_lf) create an 'onboarding' notification for the user. Matching gate ✓: persona_lf provider with lf_inps_registered=false is EXCLUDED from /pulizie/estimate binario=persona_lf; also excluded when approval_status='pending'; impresa bots unaffected. Frontend Playwright (mobile 390x844) verified: role-client/role-provider/role-business cards render; role-next on provider routes to /provider-onboarding; provider-onboarding testID mounts; 'Come lavori?' shows prof-impresa/prof-piva/prof-persona_lf cards + dob-input; picking persona_lf leads to phone step (phone-input + send-otp) with correct Italian copy 'Verifica il telefono / Ti inviamo un codice via SMS'; impresa track goes intro→profile→phone directly (no lf_edu injected before data), matching the steps memo in provider-onboarding.tsx:57-61. Twilio trial 400 handled per spec (not treated as bug per agent note).

minor.issue: After 'reject', provider_state() returns 'in_verifica' because the state function only branches on approval_status ∈ {suspended, waitlist, approved} — rejected users fall through the pending branch and, since onboarding_completed=true, are labelled 'in_verifica' instead of a dedicated 'rejected' state. Reference: /app/backend/routers/provider_onboarding.py:39-53. Consider adding explicit `if appr == 'rejected': return 'rifiutato'` so the frontend/admin UI can differentiate rejected accounts from those genuinely under review.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow. Recurs on onboarding-flow and provider-onboarding screens. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts.

action_items: (minor) Add an explicit 'rifiutato' branch in provider_state() so rejected accounts render distinctly from 'in_verifica' in status/admin panels (/app/backend/routers/provider_onboarding.py:39-53).
(minor, carried over) Migrate shadow* props to boxShadow in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts to silence the deprecation warnings on onboarding screens.
critical_code_review_comments: provider_onboarding.py (316 lines) is well-scoped and self-contained. Twilio exceptions are wrapped in HTTPException 400 with 'twilio_error: <msg>' so unverified-trial-caller errors surface cleanly to the client — matches the expected UX. ✓
Age gate _is_adult() correctly guards profile POST; role assignment (persona_lf/piva → provider, impresa → business) is deterministic. ✓
State machine 5 states (incompleto/in_verifica/attivo_inps_pending/attivo/waitlist/sospeso) derived reactively from user doc — no denormalisation drift. ✓
Admin decisions always call push_notification() with type='onboarding' — verified in Mongo. ✓

Matching gate correctly excludes persona_lf providers with lf_inps_registered==False AND rejects pending/suspended/waitlist accounts via {$nin} in compatible_providers() /app/backend/routers/richieste.py:137-144. ✓
provider-onboarding.tsx step memo correctly injects lf_edu + lf_delega only when profileType==='persona_lf'. ✓
onboarding-flow.tsx role selection routes provider/business to /provider-onboarding and keeps client on the legacy 8-step onboarding. ✓
onb-back testID is present on the header — navigation both directions works. ✓
settings-based fee config (get_fee_config) allows admin override while defaulting to €8/€4/€6 — matches spec. ✓
